content_overrides: both authored floor resources use zero-count waves; inventory, doors, movement, AI implementation and assets otherwise retained
gameplay_gate: guest takes all three gems, host observes conserved inventory and opened door; both remain alive on floor one; no mobs
backups: both copy complete checkpoints every five seconds; Kit succession metadata remains included, Replay has no external coordinator in this cohort
byte_scope: all per-connection application payload/envelope bytes sent; excludes ENet/IP framing and retransmission
time_scope: inclusive Odin game process callback wall microseconds, excluding comparison probes/driver; not CPU-only
limits: different prediction/ownership, presentation and recovery services remain part of each implementation
waypoint intent is shared; exact input trajectories and arrival positions need not agree
quiet interaction workload only; no combat or overall framework performance conclusion
mechanical source counts are not a human usability study
client_view_gate: transient predicted/partially delivered totals are recorded (0..6); final visible total must equal 3. Authority total must remain 3 in every sample.
baseline_overlay: isolated game releases the owned World2D reference after the unchanged navigation-map lookup; original Kit/game sources remain untouched; failed pristine pilot retained
interaction_timing: record visible bag/door separately, then await command confirmation plus the expected received result before advancing; no comparison of Kit prediction against Replay confirmation

observation_scopes.visible_inventory: Kit local replicated/predicted fields; Replay predicted world used by its HUD
observation_scopes.raw_state: Kit current local entity fields (may include prediction); Replay authority-observed world
